articles.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, today announced it will hold a conference call on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time to discuss its financial results for the fiscal second quarter ended October 31, 2026. The news release announcing the second quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results will be disseminated on December 1, 2026 after the market closes. Interested parties may join the conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time on Tuesday, December 1, 2026 by dialing 833-461-5787 (toll-free) or +1 585-542-9983 (international). The conference ID for the call is 413791327. It is recommended that participants dial in to the call at least 10 minutes before the start of the call. articles.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO) today announced that it has reached an agreement with Marvell Technology Inc. regarding the parties’ respective patent rights related to Active Electrical Cable (AEC) technology. The parties have also agreed to resolve Marvell’s pending challenges to Credo’s patents before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO). The terms of the agreement remain confidential. About Credo Credo’s mission is to transform connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions. Our high-speed copper and optical interconnect technologies deliver industry-leading power and performance from chip to cluster to meet the ever-expanding data infrastructure demands of AI. Our vertically integrated connectivity portfolio is comprised of our flagship purple ZeroFlap (ZF) Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and ZF optical transceivers; optical components including silicon photonics-based photonic integrated circuits (SiPho PICs)
articles.title: Credo Reaches Settlement in Patent Dispute

articles.summary: OCP Approves Two New Specifications Developed by Credo- and Oracle-Led Optics Reliability Workstream Formed to Bring Consistent Telemetry Across Vendors and Form Factors Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, and Oracle, today announced that the Open Compute Project (OCP) Community has approved two new contributions aimed at bringing enhanced telemetry to optical transceivers. The specifications were developed through the OCP Networking Project in the Optics Reliability Workstream , led by Chris Collins of Credo and Steve Manley of Oracle, to establish a common, standardized framework for optical telemetry that helps bring up AI fabrics faster and keep them running longer by minimizing network disruptions.
